services.name: Fun Fishing
services.desc: Key West fishing report winter backcountry fishing is full of surprises. Although we don’t get super cold here, January and February are our coldest months. We expect temperatures to drop down into the 50s, which will in turn lower our water temperatures. The backcountry is the first place to notice lower water temperatures as the water columns are not as deep so they are easily affected by cold north winds. How will this affect the fishing? Let’s get into that. It’s mid January and we have not had a super hard cold front just yet, but one is on the way. blurb: Guests can fish inshore, nearshore, and offshore including the Marquesas Keys and Dry Tortugas. They offer various fishing experiences such as deep sea, backcountry, wreck/reef, flats, tarpon, shark, bonefishing, and lobstering trips. Boats range from 17 to 50 ft and are equipped with high-end fishing gear and electronics exceeding Coast Guard safety requirements.
